name: link-tile
title: LinkTile
description: A clickable tile: navigates on click/Enter/Space, with an overflow (⋮) menu in its top-inline-end corner. The caller supplies the title, the menu items, the open handler and the body. Copy: the title is the destination's own name, so a reader arriving there recognises where they are.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/LinkTile.json
